svg.aria-label: Schematic cross-section of a liposome carrying small-molecule drugs
svg.text: Schematic. Not to scale. Liposomes for drug delivery are often about 50 to 200 nm across.
PEG-lipid (optional): slows removal by the body
Inner layer of lipids: together a bilayer,
in liposomes. Nucleic acids such as mRNA
usually use the lipid nanoparticle form,
